subject: PO token assignment, spend ceiling lift & line-item tidy for Onyx Logistics
messages:
From: Onyx Logistics <procurement@onyxlogistics.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: tom.reynolds@onyxlogistics.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PO token + spend ceiling bump for initial shipment

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We are ready to move forward with the pilot shipment but need two items before our finance team will issue payment: a) an assigned PO token (we prefer a single PO for the pilot with line-level quantities) and b) a temporary spend ceiling increase to cover expedited freight.

Attached is our vendor_setup_form.xlsx and a short CSV with the expected line items (ONYX_PO_Attachment_Log.csv). Can Redwood provision a PO token we can reference in our internal ledger? If you can also apply a provisional ledger stamp (we call it a "ledger seal") and raise the spend cap from $25k to $45k for 10 business days, that will allow our AP to cut the payment.

Open questions from our end:
- Will the single PO token support multiple shipping line items with separate GL codes?
- How will corrections to quantities be handled once the PO is live?
- Who should our team loop into contract/PO reconciliation if we need a mid-pipeline SKU split?

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can align with our finance cutoff tomorrow.

Best,
Kate Monroe
Procurement Manager, Onyx Logistics
Attachments: vendor_setup_form.xlsx (form), ONYX_PO_Attachment_Log.csv (line estimates)
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Request: PO token + spend ceiling bump for Onyx Logistics

Team — forwarding the ask from Onyx. Summary: they need a single PO token for the pilot, a temporary spend cap bump to $45k for 10 business days, and guidance on line-item corrections / GL-code mapping. I've attached their forms.

Requirements / proposed actions:
1) PO token generation: allocate provisional token format RED-ONX-6123 and map to account code "ONYX-PLT". We should mark it as provisional in the ledger (ledger_stamp = "provisional-stamp-6123").
2) Spend ceiling: approve +20k temporary uplift (from 25k -> 45k) for 10 business days. Need Ben to confirm billing/credit exposure and whether to tie to deal DL-3492.
3) Line-item corrections: propose we allow quantity edits up to 48 hours post PO issue; after that edits require a new PO revision number. PrIyom — can you confirm whether our flow supports GL-code per line? If not, suggest we accept a top-level account and include per-line metadata in the attachment CSV for reconciliation.

Notes: Onyx asked about SKU splits mid-pipeline; operationally we can support splits but must create a new child PO token to preserve audit trail. That's our recommended approach.

Timing: Onyx needs confirmation by EOD PT tomorrow. I flagged urgency.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
--
Onyx attachments: vendor_setup_form.xlsx, ONYX_PO_Attachment_Log.csv
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: Onyx Logistics <procurement@onyxlogistics.com>
Cc: tom.reynolds@onyxlogistics.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: PO token + spend ceiling bump for initial shipment

Hi Kate / Tom — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming Redwood's plan and next steps below.

1) Provisional PO token assigned: RED-ONX-6123
   - This will be visible in your onboarding packet and accepted by our billing system as the primary reference for the pilot.
   - Ledger stamp applied: provisional-stamp-6123 (metadata: created_by=grace, purpose=pilot, ttl=10d).

2) Temporary spend ceiling: increased to $45,000 (effective immediately)
   - Duration: 10 business days (expires 2026-05-31 23:59 UTC).
   - Billing exposure owner: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com). Ben — please confirm you are comfortable with the uplift; we will set an automatic revert on the date above unless we receive an approved extension.

3) Line-item handling and corrections
   - Quantity edits are allowed within 48 hours of PO issuance. After 48 hours, any SKU/quantity split requires a child PO token (e.g., RED-ONX-6123-A) to preserve audit logs.
   - GL codes: we support per-line GL code metadata only as reconciliation tags. For invoice posting we will map to a single top-level GL on the Redwood ledger; detailed per-line GL tags will be stored with the PO for your finance reconciliation.

4) Deliverables attached
   - vendor_setup_form.xlsx (filled with Redwood onboarding key)
   - ONYX_PO_Attachment_Log.csv (ingested into our PO staging queue)
   - ledger_stamp_guidelines.pdf (explains provisional / child token behavior)

Next steps for Onyx:
- Please confirm receipt and sign the small acknowledgement below (one-line reply OK).
- If you need a child PO for SKU splits, reply within 48 hours with the revised line quantities.

Kate — once you confirm, we'll issue the official PO record in our system and share the HubSpot deal record link for your AP team.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
